title.zh: 【Lido 上线以太坊 L2 直接质押功能，支持 Arbitrum、Base、Linea 和 Optimism】
title.en: 【Lido 上线以太坊 L2 直接质押功能，支持 Arbitrum、Base、Linea 和 Optimism】

current_state.zh: Lido launched direct ETH staking from Arbitrum, Base, Linea and Optimism, using Chainlink CCIP to automatically bridge funds to Ethereum mainnet and return wstETH on the same L2.
current_state.en: Lido launched direct ETH staking from Arbitrum, Base, Linea and Optimism, using Chainlink CCIP to automatically bridge funds to Ethereum mainnet and return wstETH on the same L2.
